description: Read what haggl.ai holds for the user's haggl ID: when it was created and the negotiations, offers and codes linked to it, newest first.
name: haggl_get_my_offers

cashback_claims.description: The user's haggl.ai cashback claims, newest first, when they have any. For a ready or paid claim, haggl_get_cashback returns its payout_url.

rate_pct.description: Share of the order total, in percent.

payout_available_at.description: ISO 8601 time the payout opens, while pending.

status.description: pending (held until payout_available_at), ready (the payout can be issued) or paid.

store.description: The store the order was at.

cashback_quotes.description: The user's cashback rates that still hold, the latest per store, when they have any: an order placed there before valid_until gets the rate.

algorithmic_price_disclosure.description: For a user in New York: show word for word, next to the rate.

rate_pct.description: Cashback rate, in percent of the order total.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 time the rate holds until.

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

consent.description: The consent on record: version, time and channel.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 time the haggl ID was created.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

last_used_at.description: ISO 8601 time it was last used.

offers.description: Negotiations linked to this haggl ID, newest first.

algorithmic_price_disclosure.description: With a discount, for a user in New York: show word for word, next to the discount.

coupon.description: The code issued for an accepted offer.

code.description: Discount code for the merchant checkout.

personalized_price_notice.description: With a discount: show word for word, next to the discount.

record.description: What the record holds: verified purchases by category and offer counts.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.
